scenarios.name: bear
scenarios.reason: Secular case: GenAI substitution bites Insights (78% of revenue); revenue declines over several years; margin holds above the COVID trough (FY2020 12.0%) on subscription cost flex; the multiple sits near the low end of its own nine-year trading range (7.46x), with 9.5x at roughly the 5th percentile. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.reason: Margin is the seven-year clean median of 18.45% (rounded to 18.5%), excluding the $150M FY25 goodwill impairment. The 14.13% full-history screening median is dragged down by the pre-2021 regime, while the last five years ran 18-21%. Revenue is consensus FY26E. The multiple is set deliberately below the 23.4x median of that nine-year trading range: a decelerating top line does not re-earn the growth-era multiple. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

scenarios.name: bull
scenarios.reason: The turn proves cyclical: FY27E re-acceleration (+4%); margin near the FY2023 best (20.94%); the multiple moves toward but stays below the median of its own trading history. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

verdict.rationale: BUY at $141.06, 6.7:1 against the 2:1 bar; a brutal secular bear still clears 2.0. The market is pricing GenAI as a structural displacement of syndicated research; our judgment is that the sell-off has overshot fair value for a still-intact business — five straight years of 18–21% operating margins, absolute EBITDA rising through the decline, ~11% trailing free-cash-flow yield, an entry near the 3rd percentile of its own nine-year multiple range. Only the top line has slowed. The trade fails if revenue never re-stabilizes — a shrinking Gartner deserving ~12x — with contract-value growth at the August print as the first test. [amended 2026-07-22: with the perimeter-corrected D&A the deep-stress case — base revenue -20% (~$5,144M) at a 13% margin and an 8x exit — reads ~1.90:1 against the 2.0 bar (was 2.02); the formal bear leg clears at ~5.8:1.]
reunderwriteTriggers: Q2-2026 print (early Aug): contract-value growth decelerates further or turns negative → deepen the bear case and re-underwrite.
